book.name: Mbouŋ to Yes Israela
book.title: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela Buk Song—Psalms

content: Iit tamtoghon tanim sa mbeb poia to Maaron mata iŋgalŋgal ghiit?

content.text: O Yoova, Tiina tiei, yom upatooŋ izam tiina irau taan isob.
Yom upambood taum pa ŋgurubam to tiina kat. Ilib pa mbeb tisob to sambam paroŋania.
Yom ughur yes ndipain ve yes to gegegeu kat pa tipait izam ve tipatooŋ tapirim.
Leso ugham koiamŋa neneeŋadi, ve upoon yes ndiran to didiaaŋ avodi. Mt 21:16
Matag izala pa sambam paroŋania, ve naghita nimam muri inepneep.
You naghita kaiyo ve pitum to yom taum ughur di tila inadi, Mbnp 1:14; Mbo 19:1+
ve naghaze: “Yei tamtoghon to taan, ninim sa mbeb poia, to yom matam iŋgalŋgal ghei?
Pughu vena to matam payei? Mbo 144:3+; Hib 2:6
Yom ughur ghei nizi ris moghon pa yes aŋela ve yom taum.
Ve upakur ghei ve ugham izamai ivot inim tiina. Hib 2:6-7
Yom ughur ghei pa niŋgin nimam muri,
ve ughur mbeb tisob tineep ila sambamai: Mbnp 1:28, 9:2
ve mbeb tisob to tineep ila su,
man tisob to tirovroov ila tata paroŋania,
ve iigh tisob to tighaughau ila te lolo.
yom upatooŋ izam tiina irau taan isob.
